newsitem.title: USA: PathoGenesis Corp sets share offering.
newsitem.headline: PathoGenesis Corp sets share offering.

text.p: PathoGenesis Corp said Friday it has pricing an offering of 2.1 million shares of common stock at $27.00 a share.
The company said in a statement it plans to use proceeds for launch costs, sales and marketing, clinical testing, research and development and general corporate purposes.
The offering was managed by Montgomery Securities, Prudential Securities Inc and Hambrecht & Quist.
PathoGenesis develops drugs for treating serious infectious diseases where there is a significant need for improved therapy.
